config.label: Base URL of your own AppCrane instance, e
config.description: Base URL of your own AppCrane instance, e.g. https://crane.example.com. Without it the connector still starts and answers tools/list from the bundled catalog, but cannot execute tools.

config.label: Your AppCrane API key, sent to the instance as the X-API-Key header
config.description: Your AppCrane API key, sent to the instance as the X-API-Key header. Required to execute tools.

config.label: Optional GitHub personal access token, sent as X-Github-Token, to unlock the github_* passthrough tools
config.description: Optional GitHub personal access token, sent as X-Github-Token, to unlock the github_* passthrough tools.
